stages.name: MT5 microstructure precursor inventory (audit)

stages.name: MT5 full causal structure mapping

stages.finding: Every corrected Discovery tick is mapped through 32 causal price-event swing scales; every $1-success source is retained and grouped without top-N or frequency pruning.

stages.name: Microstructure entry timing
